title: SOC2 evidence & vendor review scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence & vendor review (quick notes, inbox-style)

2026-02-25 09:15 - morning triage
- Quick status: need to close evidence gaps for CC3 and CC7 before March 15 audit dry-run.
- Action: collect access reviews for last 6 months (owner: Priya) - pinged in Slack.

To-do (priority order):
- [ ] Finalize vendor questionnaires for new SSO provider (Okta alternative) - due 2026-03-05.
    - Draft sent to Samira; awaiting answers on data residency and subprocessor list.
    - NOTE: confirm if vendor supports SOC2-ready DPA template (ask legal).
- [ ] Upload last 12 months of third-party penetration test report to evidence bucket (S3 path?).
    - TODO: get cert from vendor security contact (Chris M.).
- [ ] Compile change-control logs for infra (CC6) - need vs. what's in Git history.
    - Quick check: infra repo has tags for prod deploys but no owner sign-off docs.
- [ ] Schedule access review reminders for app-team and infra-team (owners: app-eng leads)
- [ ] Map audit evidence to control matrix (working doc link in Confluence).

Notes / loose thoughts:
- Evidence mapping: create a table mapping control -> evidence doc name -> S3 path/Confluence page -> owner -> status. Will start a skeleton in Confluence and copy into final evidence index.
- For CC3 (system operations): need logs retention policy confirmation. Is retention 90 or 365 days? Ops says 365 for infra logs but app logs vary. Follow up with SRE.
- CC7 (change mgmt): add PTO/rotation notes for on-call cover - looks thin for last quarter. Could use runbook snapshots as supplemental evidence.

Vendor review quick notes:
- Vendor: NimbusAuth (SSO)
    - Security contact: chris@nimbus.com (confirmed)
    - Requested: subprocessor list, SOC2 report, DPA template; awaiting SOC2 (expected 1 week).
    - Risk: stores minimal PII in assertion tokens; acceptable if DPA ok.
- Vendor: AcmePenTest
    - Last test: 2025-10-12. Report ok but no remediation tracker - ask for remediation evidence (tickets).

Questions to resolve:
- Do we have a canonical S3 path pattern for evidence? (e.g., s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/yyyy-mm-control/) - ask infra for prefix + ACL policies.
- Who is final owner for CC1 (internal org chart & HR policies)? HR? People ops? Put on Priya's radar.

Quick logs (daily):
- 2026-02-26 11:02 - created skeleton Confluence page, linked above.
- 2026-02-27 15:30 - pinged legal re: DPA template; they replied: legal will review vendor DPA and propose redlines by 2026-03-03.
- 2026-02-28 09:45 - Samira uploaded preliminary vendor questionnaire answers (NimbusAuth) to Slack; need to transfer to Confluence.

Draft checklist for audit dry-run (target 2026-03-15):
- [ ] Evidence index created and linked in audit ticket (SEC-428).
- [ ] All vendor SOC2 reports uploaded or have compensating controls noted.
- [ ] Access review logs for last 6 months (signed-off).
- [ ] Change-control artifacts for all production deploys in window.
- [ ] Incident response table + 2 recent incident postmortems uploaded.
- [ ] Policy docs (InfoSec, Access Control, Data Retention) last-reviewed within 12 months - note review dates.

Short-term next steps (today):
- 1) Move Samira's vendor answers into Confluence page and flag open Qs.
- 2) DM Chris M. about pen-test remediation tickets and ask for timeline.
- 3) Create skeleton evidence index in S3 + perms request ticket to infra.

Notes to self (TODO later):
- Add small script to pull last 12 months of CloudTrail logs for evidence export (ops help).
- Consider creating a template email to vendors requesting SOC2 + DPA to speed outreach.

End of scratchpad entry.

-- Liam
